rules.description: Every connected reference tag appears in the prompt and no unconnected tag appears.
Each selected speaker voice is explicitly bound from its exact Audio tag to its stable speaker ID.
Each connected reference has a clear use and transfer boundary.
Do not request exact old-audio copying while also requesting replacement dialogue/music for the same audio role.
Warn if requested dialogue is probably too dense for the shot duration; do not silently delete lines.
A previous video must have an intentional continuity/reference role; do not attach it automatically to a fresh scene.
